unreg:half_full_double_result.rederivation_notes: Own chain (written before reading the record): outcome = (sign of 1H margin in {A,tie,B}) x (full-game winner incl. OT in {A,B}) = 6 cells per game, summing to 1. Needed: non-market strength gap and expected total (sets half-margin location and tie mass); team half-scoring split; lattice half-margin pmf with spike at 0 (0-0, 3-3, 7-7, 10-10); second-half dynamics conditional on half state (leader clock-burn, trailer tempo/4th-down aggression, starter pull); possession order (deferral -> 2H receiver); regulation-tie probability and college OT format (2-pt from 2OT, shootout from 3OT); QB status (conference availability reports exist for P4 conference games); weather; venue. Hazards: postponement >48h fallback truncated ('resolve to a fai...'), source agency not visible. Comparison afterwards: author's mechanism and inputs match mine closely and avoid market-derived inputs, but the record repeatedly calls the partition 'nine-cell' (it is 3x2=6), the data plan says no official injury feed exists (false for P4 conference games since 2023-25), and pace / regulation-tie inputs used in stages are absent from the catalog_entry list.

findings.text: Partition miscounted throughout: catalog mechanism 'one cell of a nine-cell partition', settlement_definition 'nine cells per game (3 half states x 2 winners...)' (3x2=6, self-contradictory), s5 'all nine cells sum to one', transition-matrix measurement 'Output nine cells per game', and A-U2. With OT included the full-game leg has 2 values, so the contract space is 6 cells. The stated coherence constraint and the new input's output specification are wrong as written.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Corrected nine-cell to six-cell (3 half states x 2 winners) in catalog mechanism, settlement_definition, s3/s5 text, transition-matrix measurement/why/rationale, settlement_truth why, edge case and A-U2; coherence constraint now sums six cells.

findings.text: Data plan states 'no official injury feed in CFB' (required_data, Team depth charts note) and treats QB status as own-capture only. Big Ten (2023), SEC (2024), ACC and Big 12 (2025) publish mandatory player availability reports for conference games (web check; exact deadlines vary by source). These should be a candidate source for cfb.qb_status_pit/cfb.depth_chart, with the gap that non-conference and postseason games are uncovered.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Data plan no longer says no official feed exists: added conference availability reports (Big Ten, SEC, ACC, Big 12) as a free_scrape source for conference games only, noted non-conference/postseason uncovered, and added SOURCE_UNVERIFIED unresolved A-U5 for dates and coverage.

findings.text: catalog_entry.inputs omits ids the stages and coverage rely on: cfb.pace and cfb.period_drive_clock_budget (drives per half drive tie mass), cfb.regulation_tie_curve and cfb.two_point_shootout_rate (s4 OT path), cfb.depth_chart, cfb.coaching, cfb.scoring_trip_efficiency, cfb.clock_rules, m.lifecycle. Either add (at least pace and regulation_tie_curve) or drop them from stages so the catalog list matches the mechanism.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added to catalog_entry.inputs (with input_audit entries) every id used by stages/coverage: pace, period_drive_clock_budget, regulation_tie_curve, two_point_shootout_rate, depth_chart, coaching, scoring_trip_efficiency, clock_rules, m.lifecycle, offense_style, in_game_exit_risk, opt_out_departures, motivation, rest_travel.

findings.text: Redundancy: cfb.half_tie_conditional_win is the 0-margin row of cfb.half_to_full_transition_matrix (whose buckets include '0'); both are primary. Keep one as primary or define the tie input as a refinement of the matrix row.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Made one owner per mechanism: transition-matrix measurement now delegates its zero-margin bucket to cfb.half_tie_conditional_win, and that input audit reason states it owns the tied-half row (P(half tied), P(win|tie), receiver indicator).

findings.text: 'the side kicking off to open the game receives the second-half kickoff' is the deferral convention, not a rule; the 2H option belongs to the team that did not choose at the start. Wording should say 'usually, because toss winners defer'. Catalog interaction 4 (possession x half_split) also differs from record interaction 4 (possession x half_tie_conditional_win).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Reworded the deferral claim as a usual convention (catalog mechanism, s3, summary, possession input why) and aligned catalog interaction 4 with record interaction 4 (possession allocation x half_tie_conditional_win).

findings.text: Unsourced quantitative claim 'tie mass roughly 6-12 percent in close games' is not tied to any measurement; mark as hypothesis to be checked on CFBD line scores (2023+ clock rules).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Replaced the unsourced 6-12 percent tie-mass figure in stage s2 with a labelled hypothesis (order of ten percent, unmeasured) and added unresolved A-U6 to measure it on 2023+ CFBD line scores.

findings.text: Rules quotes checked against KXNCAAF1HFT sample: all three quotes verbatim; OT inclusion and conjunction claims correct; truncation of the >48h fallback and missing source correctly disclosed (A-U1). No overclaim found.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Confirmatory finding: I re-checked the three rules_evidence quotes against the KXNCAAF1HFT sample and they are verbatim; the truncation disclosure (A-U1) stands, so no record change was needed.

unreg:multi_leg_parlay_packs.rederivation_notes: Own chain (before reading): ML packs = P(all named teams win) = joint of per-leg win probabilities (OT guarantees a winner); true game outcomes across games are near-independent, so dependence comes only from shared epistemic error (conference offsets, common rating-model bias), and its SIGN per leg pair depends on whether the backed sides share or oppose a conference. SGP = joint pmf of (margin, total) at the strikes; dog cover + under positively dependent, fav cover + over positively dependent, key numbers 3/7. Hazards: rules_secondary empty in all four samples, so OT inclusion for spread/total legs, leg postponement/cancellation, and source are unknown; 'X at Y' wording does not imply home site (CFP semis/final are neutral; Jan 19 2026 final was at Hard Rock Stadium, Miami's home). Comparison: the record matches on structure and correctly discloses the empty rules, but asserts uniformly positive cross-leg correlation, which the sampled packs contradict.

findings.text: Dependence sign is mis-stated: s2 'Weak positive correlation per leg pair', summary 'more mass on all-hit and all-miss', and interaction 1 'the probability that all named favourites win is higher than the product'. In the sampled 4ML pack, 'Indiana wins against Alabama' backs Big Ten over SEC while 'Texas Tech wins against Oregon' backs Big 12 over Big Ten, so a Big Ten offset error moves these legs in OPPOSITE directions (negative dependence); 'Georgia wins against Ole Miss' is intra-SEC and loads on no offset. cfb.cross_game_residual_dependence must be defined on signed conference exposure of the backed side per leg, not 'games on the same date that share a conference'.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Verified from the sampled packs (Indiana over Alabama = Big Ten vs SEC; Texas Tech over Oregon = Big 12 vs Big Ten; Georgia over Ole Miss intra-SEC) and redefined cfb.cross_game_residual_dependence on signed conference exposure; rewrote summary, s2, catalog mechanism, interaction 1 and B-U2 so sign is pack-dependent.

findings.text: Overlapping inputs: cfb.rating_posterior_draws and new cfb.cross_game_residual_dependence (whose measurement is computed from the same posterior draws) are both primary; cfb.team_pair_score_covariance (s3) duplicates new cfb.margin_total_joint_pmf. Pick one owner per mechanism.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Assigned owners: rating_posterior_draws is now secondary upstream of the dependence matrix (audit and catalog role), and team_pair_score_covariance was removed from s3, coverage and feeds because margin_total_joint_pmf owns the score covariance.

findings.text: Venue: rules use 'Oregon at Indiana' / 'Miami (FL) at Indiana' for neutral-site CFP games; the Jan 19 2026 final was at Hard Rock Stadium, Miami's home venue. cfb.venue must use the actual site (and home-stadium-at-neutral cases), not the 'at' wording.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Venue audit reason and contract edge cases now require the actual site and home-stadium-at-neutral flag (final at Hard Rock Stadium, Miami); added site_name and site_is_team_home_stadium to the game dataset fields.

findings.text: Statement 'no official CFB injury report' (required_data) is false for P4 conference regular-season games (Big Ten 2023, SEC 2024, ACC/Big 12 2025 availability reports). For the sampled CFP packs, coverage of postseason games by any official report is SOURCE_UNVERIFIED; regular-season packs would be covered for conference legs.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed the blanket no-official-report claim: listed conference availability reports as free_scrape for regular-season legs, marked postseason coverage unverified, and added SOURCE_UNVERIFIED unresolved B-U4.

findings.text: m.external_lines dropped entirely. The record's own mechanism says per-leg calibration errors compound multiplicatively; de-vigged sharp leg lines should be kept as a benchmark/context input (not as a predictor) to check each leg.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added m.external_lines to catalog_entry.inputs as context with audit BENCHMARK_ONLY (not in any stage or coverage claim) and a benchmark-only required_data entry for timestamped de-vigged leg lines.

findings.text: 'Half-point strikes rule out pushes' is verified only for the one SGP sample; integer strikes in other packs are not excluded by any text. Also 'common weather' as a cross-game shock is weak for games in different cities; keep it within-game only.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Settlement definition and edge cases now say half-point no-push is verified only for the sampled same-game pack and other strikes are unseen; weather_pit removed from the cross-game stage s2 and kept within-game in s3.

findings.text: Archetype bundles two different targets (cross-game ML conjunction vs within-game margin-total joint) with disjoint primary inputs; acceptable under one key but the catalog should mark which inputs apply to which contract type.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Tagged every catalog_entry input why with its contract type ([ML packs] or [SGP]) and added an applicability sentence to the catalog mechanism, so the disjoint primary inputs of the two targets are explicit under one key.

findings.text: Rules quotes checked: all four verbatim; empty rules_secondary, OT/void/source gaps correctly disclosed (B-U1); dates (3ML all Jan 01; 4ML Dec 31 + Jan 01) correct.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Confirmatory finding: I re-checked the four rules_evidence quotes and the empty rules_secondary against the evidence pack; quotes are verbatim and gaps are disclosed in B-U1, so no change was needed.

unreg:season_stat_leader.rederivation_notes: Own chain (before reading): P(named player's regular-season total is the max over the eligible field), ties paying YES $1/N rounded down. Total = current total + sum over remaining regular-season games of P(plays) x team volume x usage share x efficiency vs opponent, overdispersed; teammates negatively correlated via shared volume, same-team players share pace/QB shocks. Stat-specific drivers: rush/rec yards (carries/targets share, explosives), pass TD (dropbacks, red-zone TD split, QB benching risk), sacks (pass-rush snaps x opponent dropbacks, 0.5 lattice). Hazards: conference title games excluded, non-conference games count, Hawaii 13th game and cancellations change game counts, 'Division I' may include FCS, NCAA counts QB sack yardage as rushing, player who does not play -> NO, source clause truncated, stat corrections. Comparison: the record matches this chain almost exactly, avoids market inputs and correctly drops the team-standings blueprint inputs; gaps are labelling and source points.

findings.text: rules_verification 'VERIFIED_FROM_RULES_TEXT' overstates: the record itself says the text is truncated before the source-of-truth clause (C-U1) and leaves FCS scope and 'play' undefined (C-U2, C-U3). Should be PARTIALLY_VERIFIED. All five quotes are verbatim and the $1/N, title-game exclusion and NO-if-not-played claims match the text.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Changed contract.rules_verification to PARTIALLY_VERIFIED because the sampled rules_secondary is truncated before the source clause and FCS scope and play are undefined (C-U1 to C-U3); all five quotes remain verbatim.

findings.text: C-U5 (availability reports unverified) can be partly closed: Big Ten (2023), SEC (2024), ACC and Big 12 (2025) publish mandatory availability reports, but only for conference games, so non-conference weeks remain uncovered. Data source for cfb.player_participation_hazard should list them with that gap.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Updated the availability dataset to list Big Ten, SEC, ACC and Big 12 conference availability reports as a free_scrape source with the non-conference gap, and rewrote C-U5 to state what remains unverified (dates, deadlines, archives).

findings.text: Participation for passing-TD leaders also includes benching/QB-competition risk (not injury); state that cfb.player_participation_hazard covers loss of the starting job, or the QB race is under-dispersed.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Valid: catalog participation_hazard measures injury only. Added new input cfb.starting_job_loss_risk (full definition) to stage s2, coverage, catalog inputs and the availability dataset, and clarified the participation-hazard audit and why text.

findings.text: Blueprint 'season_outcome' (standings, playoff format, polls) fits poorly; the actual inputs are player-volume inputs. Not harmful since the author audited them out, but the mapping note should say the blueprint inputs were replaced.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added a sentence to catalog_entry.mechanism stating the season_outcome blueprint inputs (standings, playoff format, polls, futures coherence, market ratings) were replaced by player-volume inputs for an order statistic.

findings.text: cfb.leader_race_state 'already bundles projection' overlaps cfb.stat_leader_field_simulation (which also projects remaining production); define leader_race_state as observed state only to avoid double-projecting.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: leader_race_state is now declared observed state only (current totals, gap, games remaining) in its catalog why and audit reason; its bundled projection is discarded so projection happens once in cfb.stat_leader_field_simulation.

findings.text: SOURCE_UNVERIFIED: whether CFBD/NCAA free data expose half-sack credit and post-game stat revisions with timestamps is asserted but unchecked; tie-mass calibration on a 0.5 lattice depends on it.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:C-U6
